# Regulatory Compliance Monitoring Strategy 2026

This document details the essential tasks for maintaining compliance and managing risk within the bank.

*   We need to monitor the regulatory changes for strategy 2026.
*   We need to update the regulatory changes quarterly.
*   We need to monitor the internal control based on audit.
*   We need to monitor the legal risks urgently.
*   We need to update the internal control quarterly.
